text: たとえ　まけても　おれは　ニンジャ　マスター　キョウの　おしえに　いきる　つもりだ

structure.jp: おれは　ニンジャ　マスター　キョウの　おしえに　いきる
structure.en: I live by the teachings of the ninja master Koga

patterns.name: たとえ〜ても
patterns.explanation: たとえ with a verb in ても means 'even if that happens'; たとえ warns you early that an 'even if' is coming. たとえ　まけても = 'even if I lose'.

patterns.name: 〜つもりだ
patterns.explanation: つもりだ after a verb says the speaker plans to do it. いきる　つもりだ = 'I intend to live'.
